kit_page.name: stepped_kit
kit_page.summary: Characters move on a stepped clock (on twos, threes...) while the camera and world stay smooth. Viewer-local only. Off is byte-identical.

kit_row.help: Who steps: the actor chosen below, the whole cast (you if the cast is empty), everyone in view, your friends in view, or whoever is near the camera.
kit_row.keywords: scope who cast everyone selected friends nearby close distance
kit_row.label: Applies to

kit_row.help: How far from the camera counts as nearby. Also caps every scope when Limit distance is on.
kit_row.keywords: radius nearby distance metres camera range
kit_row.label: Radius

kit_row.help: Only step actors within the radius, whatever the scope. Everyone, but only within 20 m.
kit_row.keywords: limit distance radius cap range far
kit_row.label: Limit distance

kit_row.help: Step your own avatar when Everyone, Friends or Nearby would include it. Whole cast and Selected actor follow the cast and selection.
kit_row.keywords: include me self own avatar you
kit_row.label: Include me

kit_row.help: Step Clone Studio clones even when they are outside the scope above.
kit_row.keywords: include ghost clones studio scope animation clone
kit_row.label: Include clones

kit_row.help: The selected actor: the one stepped in Selected actor scope, the target in Mixed, and the one whose override you edit below. Saved with the scene.
kit_row.label: Actor

kit_row.help: Cast members with their own stepping. Click one to edit it here.
kit_row.label: Overrides

kit_row.help: Inherit follows the page. Never keeps this actor smooth. Own settings steps it at its own rate even outside the scope.
kit_row.label: This actor

kit_row.help: Steps this actor coarser than the page: +1 step holds each pose one more base frame, so twos become threes. Beats the group rate.
kit_row.keywords: actor rate offset coarser slower threes
kit_row.label: Rate offset

kit_row.help: Which body part the Part rate below overrides for this actor. Torso is the base rate and has no override.
kit_row.keywords: actor part head face arms hands legs extras attachments override
kit_row.label: Part

kit_row.help: This actor's rate for the chosen part. Inherit follows the Part rates card; Smooth never holds that part. Beats the page and the group. Saved with the scene.
kit_row.keywords: actor part rate override inherit same smooth coarser
kit_row.label: Part rate

kit_row.help: The rate this actor steps at now, after its group and its own offset. Rate variation shows as up to N% longer steps.
kit_row.label: Effective

kit_row.help: This actor's stepped rate in frames per second.
kit_row.label: Own rate

kit_row.help: What steps for this actor. Inherit uses the What steps card.
kit_row.label: Own steps

kit_row.help: In Mixed rate mode: Auto makes the selected actor the target; Target or Background forces this actor's role.
kit_row.label: Mixed role

kit_row.help: Removes this actor's own stepping settings so it follows the page again.
kit_row.label: Clear

kit_row.help: Keeps smooth any actor a camera rides: you in mouselook, the Bone Lock subject and VCam bone-POV anchors. Stops judder in POV shots.
kit_row.keywords: exclude mouselook bone lock pov camera
kit_row.label: Skip camera rigs

kit_row.help: Most actors stepped at once. The selected actor, overrides and the cast come first, then the nearest. Keeps crowds fast.
kit_row.label: Max actors

kit_row.help: How many actors are stepping now, at what rate, and any actors skipped and why.
kit_row.label: Status

kit_row.help: Fixed steps at one rate. Adaptive goes smoother on fast action and steps on slow holds. Mixed steps the target and the background at different rates.
kit_row.label: Mode

kit_row.help: Quick rates against the base fps: on ones, twos, threes or fours. 2s at 24 is 12 fps.
kit_row.label: On

kit_row.help: Pose updates per second. In Mixed this is the target's rate.
kit_row.label: Rate

kit_row.help: The rate expressed against the base fps, e.g. 12 fps = on twos at 24.
kit_row.label: Reads as

kit_row.help: Rate used during fast action. 24 is on ones at 24; 0 or 1 is fully smooth.
kit_row.label: Fast rate

kit_row.help: Limb speed, relative to the hips, above which the fast rate takes over.
kit_row.label: Threshold

kit_row.help: How far below the threshold the speed must fall before stepping resumes, as a fraction (at least 0.05). Stops flicker.
kit_row.label: Hysteresis

kit_row.help: Shortest time either rate is kept before switching again. Never less than one step.
kit_row.label: Min hold

kit_row.help: Live limb speed of the selected actor and which rate it is on, for tuning the threshold.
kit_row.label: Limb speed

kit_row.help: Rate for everyone in scope who is not a target. 8 is on threes at 24; 0 or 1 is smooth.
kit_row.label: Background

kit_row.help: Pose holds the body's joints. Pose + position also holds where the character stands, so travel steps too.
kit_row.label: Steps

kit_row.help: Steps the neck, head and eyes with the body. Off keeps gaze and look-at smooth.
kit_row.keywords: gaze look at eyes head neck
kit_row.label: Gaze & look-at

kit_row.help: Flexi prims and avatar physics on this actor update only on steps. Off lets them sway smoothly.
kit_row.label: Hair, cloth & flexi

kit_row.help: Steps particle emission and scripted spin on this actor's attachments. Use Step particles for in-flight particle motion.
kit_row.label: Attachment FX

kit_row.help: Hold motion, age, colour and size of this actor's particles between steps; catch up on the next tick. HUD sources stay smooth.
kit_row.label: Step particles

kit_row.help: Step texture animation: Hold animated textures on this actor's attachments between steps, then jump to the current frame. HUD attachments stay smooth.
kit_row.keywords: texture animation offset rotation animesh attachments
kit_row.label: Step textures

kit_row.help: Capture time follows the World clock, so slow-motion renders still land exact twos. Real time steps per real second.
kit_row.label: Clock

kit_row.help: Random gives each actor its own step timing. Locked steps everyone together. Manual uses the phase below.
kit_row.label: Actor offset

kit_row.help: Shifts every actor's step timing, as a fraction of one step.
kit_row.label: Phase

kit_row.help: The film rate the 1s to 4s chips count against.
kit_row.label: Base fps

kit_row.help: Same seed, same look. It changes every actor's timing, boil and rate, the same on every take.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: Picks a new random seed, so every actor gets a different look. Viewer-local.
kit_row.label: New seed

kit_row.help: How staggered the actors are when Actor offset is Random. 0 steps everyone in lockstep, 1 staggers fully.
kit_row.label: Phase spread

kit_row.help: Spreads each actor's step length on its own grid: twos can land on threes and fours, a 10 or 30 fps step can double. Never faster than the rate. Off while Match Roto Ink is on.
kit_row.label: Rate variation

kit_row.help: Now and then an actor holds one extra step, like hand-timed animation. Never twice in a row.
kit_row.keywords: imperfect timing jitter hand drawn extra hold
kit_row.label: Imperfect timing

kit_row.help: The cast's group tags. Pick one to set how coarse it steps. Saved with the scene.
kit_row.keywords: group tag cast crowd hunters demons
kit_row.label: Group

kit_row.help: Hunters on twos, demons on threes: +1 step holds each pose one base frame longer. Untagged actors use the page rate. Saved with the scene.
kit_row.label: Group rate

kit_row.help: Every cast group that has its own rate. Click one to edit it.
kit_row.label: All groups

kit_row.help: Tiny random jitter on held poses, like stop-motion or clay. The same every playback.
kit_row.label: Pose boil

kit_row.help: Largest jitter per joint, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: How many steps each jitter lasts. 1 is the fastest boil.
kit_row.label: Boil every

kit_row.help: Hit-stop: when a limb stops sharply, the pose holds for a few extra steps.
kit_row.label: Hold on impact

kit_row.help: Extra steps the impact pose is held.
kit_row.label: Frames

kit_row.help: How sharply a limb must slow down to count as an impact. Lower triggers more often.
kit_row.label: Threshold

kit_row.help: On a fast step, the moving limb is drawn stretched between its old and new pose for one step, like an anime smear.
kit_row.label: Smear frames

kit_row.help: How far the smear stretches and lags the limb.
kit_row.label: Strength

kit_row.help: Limb speed, relative to the hips, a step must reach to smear.
kit_row.label: Smear speed

kit_row.help: Biases held poses toward the extremes of a move, for snappy key poses.
kit_row.keywords: ease spacing extremes key poses snappy
kit_row.label: Ease spacing

kit_row.help: How strongly held poses lean toward the nearest extreme. 0 holds the plain sample.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: Sets Roto Ink's redraw fps and hold frames to this rate, so the ink boils with the steps. While this is on, group and actor rate offsets and rate variation are off, so the steps stay on Roto's cadence. Own rates, the Mixed background rate and the Adaptive fast rate keep their own values and are not re-timed to Roto. Does not turn Roto Ink on.
kit_row.keywords: roto ink match redraw sketch fps
kit_row.label: Match Roto Ink

kit_row.help: Ink lines, sketch boil and line motion are on the Roto Ink page.
kit_row.label: Roto Ink

kit_row.help: Neon grid, rim and trails are on the Tron page.
kit_row.label: Tron

kit_row.help: Per-actor looks and their effect fps are on the Actor FX page.
kit_row.label: Actor FX

kit_row.help: Capture time is the World clock on the Time page; slow it down there for exact stepped renders.
kit_row.label: World clock

kit_row.help: Neck, head and eyes (the Gaze joints) on their own grid. The torso (pelvis, spine, chest, collars) is the base rate every part is measured against; +1 step holds a part one base frame longer than the torso.
kit_row.keywords: part rate head neck eyes gaze spider verse twos threes
kit_row.label: Head

kit_row.help: Face bones and lip-sync on their own grid. Smooth keeps the face smooth on a stepped body (Face & lip-sync off in presets and scenes). The eyes are not here: they follow Head, with Gaze.
kit_row.keywords: part rate face lip sync mouth bento smooth
kit_row.label: Face

kit_row.help: Shoulders, elbows and wrists. Hands ride on the arms, so they follow the held arm even on their own rate. Actors in a cast group with its own rate ignore the page's part rates (actor > group > page).
kit_row.keywords: part rate arms shoulders elbows wrists
kit_row.label: Arms

kit_row.help: Fingers (Bento hand bones).
kit_row.label: Hands

kit_row.help: Hips, knees, ankles, feet and toes. Different from Torso can make feet slide.
kit_row.keywords: part rate legs hips knees ankles feet toes slide
kit_row.label: Legs

kit_row.help: Bento tail, wings, hind limbs and groin.
kit_row.keywords: part rate extras tail wings hind limbs groin bento
kit_row.label: Extras

kit_row.help: Rigid attachments and worn animesh. Rigged clothing follows the bones it is rigged to. Spider-Punk: body on twos, accessories on threes. A cast group with its own rate steps its actors on one grid and ignores these part rates.
kit_row.keywords: part rate attachments rigid worn animesh accessories rigged
kit_row.label: Attachments
